{{Top|leg}}
The '''Common Room of Honoghr''' was located inside the [[Grand Dukha]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nystao]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]]. It was the location of the [[High Seat]] from which [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] addressed the [[dynast]]s.
